item.title: SCV 101: Julio Lemos, Owner of Julio Lemos Insurance - SCVTV.com
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda talks to Julio Lemos, the owner of Julio Lemos Insurance to talk about his business that he's been running in Santa Clarita for nearly 30 years where he prides himself on the service he offers to the community. Julio also tells us about all the important work he does to advocate and support the Latino community.

item.title: Circle of Hope's Creative Writing Class Debuts Poetry Collection 'In Awe of Becoming' - SCVTV.com
item.description: Circle of Hope is a nonprofit organization that provides support services, financial assistance and wellness programs to those going through their cancer journey. One such program has created such a sense of community, it inspired the publication of Circle of Hope's first book, "In Awe of Becoming."

item.title: Enjoy Some Yuletide Cheer at TMU's Beloved Tradition, 'Come Christmas Sing & Market' - SCVTV.com
item.description: The Master’s University Paul T. Plew School of Music has been dazzling audiences for 41 years with its Come Christmas Sing, a holiday staple that brings the festive sounds of the season to Santa Clarita!

item.title: SCVTV's Community Corner Season 6, Episode 29 - SCVTV.com
item.description: In this episode of SCVTV’s Community Corner, co-hosts Carrie Lujan and Dave Caldwell kick things off with a recap of recent (and soggy) community events including Bridge to Home's Turkey Trot and Light Up Main Street. They also give us a sneak preview of Santa Clarita Symphony Orchestra's family-friendly concert, "Sounds of the Season."

item.title: Opening Segment: Rainy Recap of SCV Holiday Events; Hear How You Can Enjoy Santa Clarita Symphony Orchestra's 'Sounds of the Season' - SCVTV.com
item.description: Rain didn't dampen the holiday spirits of the hundreds of Santa Clarita Valley community members, including co-host Carrie Lujan, who braved the stormy weather to take part in recent meaningful events

item.title: Dec. 5: Henry Mayo Holiday Home Tour Gala 'Saving Hearts Close to Home' - SCVTV.com
item.description: Tis the season for festive cheer and purposeful giving at the highly-anticipated tradition Henry Mayo Holiday Home Tour Gala Friday, Dec 5, at 6 p.m., at the Hyatt Regency Valencia.

item.title: SCV Water Explains Why You Should Pause Outdoor Watering - SCVTV.com
item.description: SCV Water Agency customers are being asked to put a pause on all outdoor water use from Dec. 14-Dec. 22 as part of the scheduled, ongoing maintenance at Castaic Lake.
